name: OpenCode Go / Go Plus
summary: Coding-agent subscription with model-dependent usage accounting and concurrent plan windows.

setupSteps.title: Choose the workspace
setupSteps.description: Use a single-member workspace and select the desired Go or Go Plus subscription yourself.

setupSteps.title: Create a key
setupSteps.description: Copy a personal workspace API key with Models Request permission. Store only in the secret store.

setupSteps.title: Choose an explicit protocol route
setupSteps.description: Select the endpoint family from the model table; Chat, Responses, Anthropic and Gemini are not interchangeable.

setupSteps.title: Keep Extra Usage disabled
setupSteps.description: Extra Usage can spend PAYG credits after allowance exhaustion. Enabling paid overflow requires deliberate user configuration.

setupSteps.title: View current allowance
setupSteps.description: Until a public Go allowance schema is verified, show the live balance and reset as unknown and link to Console.
